sources.label: Personal Morphe patches. Made by AI (Claude), not me. Personal use only.
sources.author: SledgeSune
patch_list: Stops usage analytics from being sent to Firebase, Mixpanel, Singular and Facebook.
Removes all ads (banners, native, interstitial and app-open ads), the same way the "No Ads" purchase does. Other Premium features stay locked.
Skips the "Go Pro" screen after sign-up and hides Premium sales banners, the Premium sheet after SMS, Premium promo notifications and upgrade banners in the call history.
Stops "aggressive mode" from hiding the phone's navigation bar.
Removes the "free gift" card after calls and banners promoting other apps.
